title: ECDSA NULL ptr: eccsign.in/eccverify.hash/sig unchecked
description:
crypto2dev_ecdsa() dereferences three caller-supplied pointers without a NULL guard before XMEMCPY:
- info->pk.eccsign.in (line 1348): copied to sign_op.digest without checking for NULL
- info->pk.eccverify.hash (line 1406): copied to verify_op.digest without checking for NULL
- info->pk.eccverify.sig (line 1412): copied to verify_op.sig without checking for NULL

Trigger: caller passes NULL digest/sig pointer with nonzero inlen/hashlen/siglen.
Outcome: SIGSEGV / process crash.

Fix: add NULL guard before each XMEMCPY, returning BAD_FUNC_ARG.
The verify path already checks key==NULL and res==NULL (line 1383) but misses hash and sig.
